title: mmt-bench corpus manifest (corpus/manifest.yaml)
description: Every capture of the corpus, by sha256, with its source, licence, size, packet count, average packet size and ground-truth file (plan §B6). Captures are never committed: each path is under the manifest's git-ignored data/ directory. A local_only entry is shown in results and reports only by its label and sha256.

label.description: The name results and reports use, unique in the manifest.

path.description: Relative to the manifest's directory, under its git-ignored data/ directory.

avg_packet_bytes.description: The average original (wire) length of a packet, 2 decimals.

source.description: Where the capture comes from: a URL, a dataset name, or the command that generated it.

licence.description: An SPDX identifier or the dataset's own licence name.

ground_truth.description: The ground-truth file, relative to the manifest's directory; null for a benign capture, where no alert is expected.

local_only.description: True for a capture that is never committed or published (the anonymised dgx-spark capture): results and reports show only its label and sha256.

generator.description: For a set written by mbench corpus gen: the parameters that regenerate it byte for byte.
